I need an exhaustive analysis of the Webflow Our Works page for a pixel-perfect Next.js rebuild. Read these files thoroughly:

1. Read the FULL file: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/boldteq-v1-0.webflow/our-works.html
   - Extract every section in order (hero, filter header, sidebar, card grid, pagination JS, popup JS, CTA, footer sections)

   - .work-banner, .transparent-bg
   - .filter_wrapper, .filter_header, .filter_grid, .filter_column, .filter_content
   - .filter_search-field, .filter_tag, .filter_tag-text, .filter_tag-remove, .filter_tags-wrapper, .filter_tags-text
   - .filter_sort-by, .sort-text, .sort_field, .dropdown, .sort-dropdown, .dropdown_list
   - .filter_block, .filter_block-header, .filter_reset, .filter_reset-all, .filter_results-text, .filter-bar-title
   - .checkbox_field, .checkbox_input, .checkbox_label, .cat-name-item, .cmg-soon, .work-cat-comingsoon, .option-results
   - .content_collection-list, .content_card, .content_card-image, .content_card-block, .category-name, .category-name.abs, .eye-icon
   - .work-cms-item, .cms-link, .cms-image-link
   - .global-popup, .popup-container, .popup-close, .popup-close-icon, .popup-iframe, .popup-iframe-full, .popup-iframe-gallery

   - .result-count, .cms-result, .result-work, .text-color-green

   - .coming-soon-cms, .cg-soon
   - .hide (display none class)
   - .padding-vertical, .filt-out, .full-width

For each CSS class, include the base styles AND every @media query variant (min-width:1280px, min-width:1440px, max-width:991px, max-width:767px, max-width:479px).

3. Extract the COMPLETE JavaScript from the our-works.html page:
   - The popup open/close logic (click handler on .work-cms-item)
   - The pagination logic (itemsPerPage=8, button creation, page navigation)
   - The checkbox disable logic for coming-soon items
   - Any inline CSS in <style> blocks

Be extremely thorough - every CSS value matters for 1:1 matching.
